scripts.build:worker: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=production opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc --env "" && node ../../scripts/game-release.mjs prepare-assets --game genshin --environment production
scripts.preview: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=preview opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging && node ../../scripts/game-release.mjs prepare-assets --game genshin --environment staging && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=preview opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging && node ../../scripts/game-release.mjs prepare-assets --game genshin --environment staging && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.verify:bundle: pnpm run build:worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --env ""
